note: Patrick County (51141) has no county zoning ordinance: the county's Economic Development page says it does not have zoning, a January 2026 county memo says it operates without zoning ordinances under the Dillon Rule, and 2025 Planning Commission minutes say the county lacks zoning. The only town, Stuart (county seat), publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (Stuart-Zoning-Map.pdf) and its ordinance as a PDF; no queryable zoning polygon service was found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or on the county's InteractiveGIS portal (login-gated). Third-party zoning aggregators (zoneomics, Regrid) are not official sources and were not used.
